title: Fall with gravity
prompt: Gravity adds gravity pixels per second to a falling speed every second (down is positive). Return the vertical speed after one frame.
signature: func solve(vy: float, gravity: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(vy: float, gravity: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return vy
hint: Same shape as accelerating a car, with gravity as the acceleration.
solution:
func solve(vy: float, gravity: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return vy + gravity * delta
